unknown_rule: Published is_public_holiday is true or false only. Dates in an incomplete year are omitted from the release.
transcription: Years 2018 through 2026 were read from presidential proclamations on https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/ on 2026-10-25. A later proclamation replaces the annual list when it amends that list. Eid dates come from the proclamation that sets the date. Special working days are recorded and do not set the public flag. Shape tests are stored separately and are not proclamations.
